entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah, VeloFit agent ID 303. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, um, I think I need to return something? I bought some shoes, and I'm just... I'm not sure what to do. The website was a bit confusing.
I can certainly help you with that. To pull up your order, could I get your name and the order number, please?
Yes, the name is Mark Peterson. The order number is... VF77819.

Thank you, Mark. One moment... Okay, I see your order for the VeloFit Pro-Grip cycling shoes, delivered on January 9th. So I can best assist you, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the shoes? Is it a technical fault or more of a sizing or preference issue?

Oh, it's the fit. I thought I got the right size, but I went for one ride and they gave me terrible blisters. And I don't even understand how to attach the cleats properly. I'm just so lost with all of this. Can't you just help me?
I absolutely understand, Mark. Getting the right fit is the most important part of new cycling shoes, and it can be frustrating when they cause issues like blisters. I can definitely help you.
So... can I send them back? I wasn't sure what the policy was.
Yes, you can. For standard apparel like our shoes, we have a 90-day return window. Since you're only on day 7, you're well within that period. We can absolutely process a full refund for you.
Oh, a full refund? That's a huge relief. Thank you so much. I was so worried.

You're very welcome. I'm emailing you a pre-paid return label right now. Just print it out, attach it to the original box, and you can drop it off at any postal service location. Once we receive the shoes, your refund will be processed back to your original payment method within 3-5 business days.
Okay, that sounds simple enough. Thank you for making it easy.
Of course. Is there anything else I can help you with today, Mark?
No, that was it. Thanks again, Sarah.
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
